correctness.rationale: Restrict every S^d Gegenbauer kernel (d>=2) to S², obtaining a convex combination of same-parity Legendre polynomials. Direct low Legendre values at 1/2 plus Laplace integral absolute bound 10643/32768<1/3 for degree>=8 imply even p>=-1/3 and odd p<=1/2. Exact cubic angular Bernstein images in A(u)=arcsin(u) yield nonnegative coefficient families; the identity [u^{2k+1}]A³/[u^{2k+1}]A=6 sum_{j=1}^k(2j-1)^{-2}<3pi²/4 proves the odd case at all k; its first 16 ratios were independently checked exactly. Schoenberg then lifts all nonnegative basis mixtures to Psi_infty. Degree4 P6 midpoint value -17/256 was recomputed independently; degrees>=5 P2 yield (1-3 cos(pi/n)^n)/4<0; S1 B_n cos(2theta) midpoint negative for n>=3. Thus the dimension/degree boundaries and limits are proved analytically, not by the bounded script.
